label: Signed rare transition: up after a1->S2, down after a2->S1, plus unrewarded boost.
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 41 encodes the signed rare transition. state - action is +1 for a rare a1->S2 transition, -1 for a rare a2->S1 one, and 0 for common ones. The unit carries this at D2 right after the transition is seen (weight about 0.36), and more strongly at the next D1 (about 0.74). An unrewarded last trial adds roughly +0.28 at D1 and D2. GO is pinned near -1 and carries almost nothing. All terms are observed when used: at D2 the choice and state are already known. The free fit (dev 0.71 vs short 0.69) adds only a small main effect of S2 at D1 and a weak belief_lo term at D2. The remaining misses are D1 effects of the trial before, e.g. under-prediction after a2 S2 u and over-prediction after a1 S1.

issues: Minor: the label does not say which phases carry the effect. The signed-transition weight is about 0.74 at the next D1, about 0.36 at D2, and about 0 at GO.

Leftover systematic error at D1 in the misses: under-predicted by +0.28 after a2 S2 u (a common transition, where state - action = 0, but the residual is about +0.50) and over-predicted by about -0.18 after a1 S1 r/u. So an unrewarded S2 visit at D1 pushes the unit up by more than the shared reward term allows. Adding (phase==D1)*(prev_state==2)*(prev_reward==0) to a free fit only lifts test R^2 from 0.681 to 0.715.

Fitting state and action with separate weights (D1: +0.79 for S2, -0.71 for a2; D2: +0.31 / -0.41) gets test R^2 0.705, close to the short form's 0.681. This supports the equal-weight 'state - action' shape and shows it is not curve fitting.

Alternative 3-term forms all scored lower on test: reward term at D1 only 0.614, at D2 only 0.582, weighted 2*S2 - a2 at D1 0.595, prev_state==2 alone at D1 0.381. The recorded short form looks close to the best possible with 3 terms. The ceiling from all observed variables is 0.78.
